name: xldx
description: A powerful Excel file builder for TypeScript/JavaScript with advanced styling and theming capabilities
author: Jeff Wainwright <https:jeffry.in> (yowainwright@gmail.com)

scripts.build:pkg: bun run clean && bun run build:browser && bun run build:node && bun run build:types
scripts.build:node: bun build src/server/index.ts --outfile dist/server/index.js --target node --minify --external fs --external fs/promises --external buffer
scripts.build:types: tsc --ignoreConfig --strict --noImplicitReturns --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --skipLibCheck --target esnext --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun-types --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --rootDir src --outDir dist src/index.ts src/browser/index.ts src/server/index.ts
scripts.lint:run: bun scripts/lint/index.ts && src-lint check tests --strict && src-lint check scripts --strict && bun run format:check
scripts.lint:imports: legibility --config .legibilityrc --linter src-lint && src-lint check tests --strict && src-lint check scripts --strict
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts --deny-warnings src tests scripts oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts --fix
scripts.format:run: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --write src tests scripts oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json turbo.json .fs-lintrc .legibilityrc .src-lintrc
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --config oxfmt.config.ts --check src tests scripts oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json turbo.json .fs-lintrc .legibilityrc .src-lintrc
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && turbo run build:pkg

ledger.reason: get-uri 8.0.1 requires the vulnerable basic-ftp 5.x line. Use patched 6.2.6 for CVE-2026-102990, CVE-2026-126345, and CVE-2026-126346; the Client API used by get-uri was checked. Remove when the parent accepts a patched version.
